locations.name: Materials Yard
locations.apprentice: Gain 3 resources in any combination of Clay and Wood.
locations.apprenticeZh: 获得共3份黏土和/或柴薪，可任意组合。
locations.shifu: Gain 4 resources in any combination of Clay and Wood. Then you may pay 1 Coin to gain +1 Clay and +1 Wood.
locations.shifuZh: 获得共4份黏土和/或柴薪，可任意组合。然后可支付1铜钱，额外获得1黏土和1柴薪。

locations.name: Private Potter's Wheel
locations.apprentice: Pay the normal Clay cost to form 1 vessel.
locations.apprenticeZh: 支付正常黏土费用，成型1件器物。
locations.shifu: Form up to 2 vessels. If you form 2, reduce their total Clay cost by 1.
locations.shifuZh: 成型至多2件器物。若成型2件，其总黏土费用减1。

locations.name: Private Glaze & Decoration
locations.apprentice: Apply a Glaze and Decoration to 1 shaped vessel; pay normally.
locations.apprenticeZh: 为1件已成型器物施釉并装饰，正常支付费用。
locations.shifu: Apply Glaze and Decoration to up to 2 shaped vessels; one Decoration applied by this action costs 0 Coins.
locations.shifuZh: 为至多2件已成型器物施釉并装饰；本次行动施加的其中1种装饰费用为0铜钱。

locations.name: Kiln Yard
locations.apprentice: Load 1 glazed ceramic into an empty active Shared Kiln space, or into your empty unlocked Imperial Kiln.
locations.apprenticeZh: 将1件已施釉陶瓷装入空置的有效共窑格；若私人御窑已解锁且为空，也可装入御窑。
locations.shifu: Load up to 2 glazed ceramics; one may enter your empty Imperial Kiln. After Base Heat, before Fire, you may reposition 1 of your Shared-Kiln ceramics.
locations.shifuZh: 装入至多2件已施釉陶瓷，其中1件可进入空置御窑。基础热度确定后、翻开窑火牌前，可移动自己在共窑中的1件陶瓷。

locations.name: Commission Market
locations.apprentice: Reserve 1 face-up Main Order, refill immediately, then gain 1 Clay, 1 Wood or 1 Coin.
locations.apprenticeZh: 预留1张正面主订单，立即补牌，然后获得1黏土、1柴薪或1铜钱。
locations.shifu: Reserve up to 2 face-up Main Orders, refilling after each, then gain 1 Clay, 1 Wood or 1 Coin total.
locations.shifuZh: 预留至多2张正面主订单，每次拿取后立即补牌，然后总共获得1黏土、1柴薪或1铜钱。

locations.name: Guild & Academy
locations.apprentice: Pay the printed Coin cost and take 1 face-up Advanced Tech.
locations.apprenticeZh: 支付印刷的铜钱费用，拿取1个正面高级技术。
locations.shifu: Refresh 1 discipline, then take 1 face-up Advanced Tech from it for 1 Coin less, minimum 0.
locations.shifuZh: 刷新1个学科，然后以少1铜钱（最低0）的费用从该学科拿取1个正面高级技术。
